display.title: WOW Nightswarm — The Pale Sovereign
display.description: A colossal reaper rises from the burning earth once a day. Hunters of WOW NIGHTSWARM band together to bring him down: dodge his scythe, leaping slams, lava eruptions and soul bolts. Everyone who fights shares the loot — cosmetic relics worn in the castle and gold for your bank. Gold, weapons and progress are shared with the main castle (-106,76). Created by @bitcoinisnotall on X.
